# Sentinel Gearhulk

## Tier 3 Solo

A hulking humanoid automaton of weathered bronze, powered by ancient magic and unwavering in its duty.

**Motives & Tactics:** Protect the Artifact, Deny Unauthorized Access, Preserve the Palace, Prioritize the Greatest Threat

> Difficulty: 17 | Thresholds: 20/40 | HP: 10 | Stress 6
> ATK: +4 | Fist Slam: Very Close | 2d12+3 phy

## Features

**Relentless (3) - Passive:** The Gearhulk can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

**Threat Assessment - Passive:** The Gearhulk only attacks creatures it identifies as threats. A creature bearing another Ancient Artifact is recognized as an authorized presence and isn't considered a valid target unless it attacks first.

**Arcane Depletion - Passive:** While the Gearhulk has no unmarked Stress, its Standard attack deals 2d8+2 damage instead.

**Core Surge - Action:** Make a Standard attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll and push back the target to Close range.

**Emergency Reinforcement - Action:** Mark a Stress to either recover 2 HP or gain +3 to both Damage Thresholds until the end of the Gearhulk's next spotlight.

**Core Recalibration - Action:** The Gearhulk vents excess arcane energy. Spend a Fear to recover 1d4+1 Stress. You may only use this once per encounter.

**Momentum - Reaction:** When the Gearhulk makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

> **Design notes:** Designed as the final encounter of a major story arc, this Gearhulk emphasizes protection over aggression. Its abilities reinforce the fantasy of an ancient guardian that only resorts to violence when it identifies a genuine threat to the artifact under its care.
